source_documentation.applies_to: MBS item and patient-demographic statistical reports
observations: The demographic report describes patient age range and gender for an MBS item.
State or Territory is based on the patient's address at the time of claiming.
Month is based on the date the service was processed, not the date it was provided.
Service totals subtract later-day adjustments and may be negative.
Older item numbers requested in some report periods may be reported under a current equivalent item number.
limitations: The live page is mutable and did not provide a stable content digest for this qualification.
Current privacy and demographic-category behavior is not projected onto historical values without exact-era evidence.

source_documentation.publisher: Services Australia via the existing data.gov.au catalogue record
source_documentation.applies_to: The existing 1993-2015 historical patient-demographics workbook and CSV series
observations: The historical files are quarterly MBS patient-demographics reports.
The dataset description defines the report as patient age range, gender, services, and total benefit amount by MBS item and State or Territory.
The historical report notes use the claim-processing month and define service totals as claims less later-day adjustments.
limitations: The repository copy is a metadata mirror of the data.gov.au description, not a new dataset source.
The catalogue record does not define historical category values, the currency code, or the benefit calculation formula.

source_column_meanings.meaning: Year component of the report period, paired with the source-defined processing month.
limits: No service-year or fiscal-year interpretation is asserted.
No value conversion or cross-era pooling is qualified.

source_column_meanings.meaning: Month in which the service claim was processed, not the month the service was provided.
limits: Preserve native month labels; no month-number conversion is qualified.

source_column_meanings.meaning: MBS item number referencing a Medicare service.
limits: Item numbers can change and some report requests can be remapped to a current equivalent.
No current-schedule identity or historical equivalence is asserted.

source_column_meanings.meaning: State or Territory dimension based on the patient's address when the service was claimed.
limits: Native category values and code normalization remain unresolved.

source_column_meanings.meaning: Patient age-range demographic dimension for the MBS item report.
limits: Age-band boundaries, reference date, suppression tokens, and value taxonomy remain unresolved.

source_column_meanings.meaning: Patient gender demographic dimension for the MBS item report.
limits: Historical labels, value taxonomy, and suppression tokens remain unresolved.
No normalization or clinical-sex interpretation is asserted.

source_column_meanings.meaning: Reported service total for processed MBS claims, after later-day adjustments.
limits: Values may be negative after adjustments.
Services are not distinct patients or a patient denominator.

source_column_meanings.meaning: Reported total benefit amount associated with MBS items and State or Territory; the native header denotes dollar units.
limits: Benefit amount calculation and adjustment treatment are not established.
No payable patient benefit or expenditure claim is made.
